property_summary: For any nonzero contract balance, a call to withdrawAll by the owner actually executes a value transfer to msg.sender, so it reverts when the owner is a non-payable contract (the test contract); the mutant sends no funds at all and therefore succeeds, violating the rule.
change_summary: Delete the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll sends no funds and no revert on empty.
